title: Escape Games Live
specs: Immersive, experiential entertainment with real puzzles and challenges
Rooms include themes like Sherlock Holmes, 1980s, jungle, circus, and world travel
Some rooms have jump scares and dark atmospheres (CarnEvil, Jungle)
Any age welcome; no charge for age 7 and younger
Children 12 or younger must be accompanied by a paying adult
Suggested age 8-12 for Young Sherlock room
Standard rooms accommodate up to 8, 10, or 16 players in York; up to 10 in Lemoyne
Groups of 6-16 divided into two teams in Around the World in 80 Minutes
